tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches the Softwear Prints catalogue of textiles and promotional items that can be printed or embroidered. Supports free text and filters for category, brand, colour, size, target group, material, certification and price. Returns name, brand, article number, unit price (net and gross), colours and a link to the product page.

query.description: Free-text search, e.g. 'polo shirt organic cotton'.

category.description: Category slug or id as returned by list_categories.

color.description: Colour names in German or English, e.g. ['navy'] or ['rot'].

price_basis.description: Whether price_min and price_max include German VAT (gross) or not (net).

page_size.description: Products per page. With a colour filter a page can hold more or fewer products.

language.description: Language of product names in the result.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns the details of one product: description, properties such as material and certifications, colours, sizes, unit price (net and gross), EAN and stock per variant, and the minimum quantities and production time for decoration.

product.description: Product slug or id as returned by search_products.

color.description: Limit the variant list to one colour name, e.g. 'Navy'.

language.description: Language of names and texts in the result.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Returns the category tree of the Softwear Prints catalogue with product counts and links. The slugs can be used as the category filter of search_products.

parent.description: Slug or id of a category to list only its subcategories. Omit for the whole tree.

language.description: Language of category names in the result.

tools.name: start_own_shop
tools.description: Explains the Softwear Prints online shop plans (free, Professional, Enterprise) with prices and returns a link to set up an own shop on softwear-prints.com (staff shop, club or team shop, school, merchandise or event shop), prefilled with the organisation name and type. The user completes the setup and the account on the website; this tool sends nothing.

organisation.description: Name of the shop or organisation, used to prefill the shop name. Optional.

organisation_type.description: Kind of organisation, used to prefill the setup: company, staff_shop, club, fire_brigade, school, university, public_authority, brand, artist, merchandise or region_tourism. Optional.

plan.description: Plan to preselect. Without it the setup starts with the free plan; the user can change it there.

billing.description: Billing period to preselect for paid plans.
